name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
description: 65 × 30 mm single-board computer with the RP3A0 quad-core Cortex-A53 SiP, 512 MB RAM, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 4.2.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Broadcom BCM2710A1 (RP3A0 SiP), quad-core Cortex-A53 @ 1 GHz

specs.label: I/O
specs.value: Unpopulated 40-pin GPIO footprint, 1× micro-USB OTG, mini-HDMI, CSI-2 camera, microSD

envelope.axes: x = long edge (65), y = short edge (30); origin = bottom-left corner, ports on the bottom edge, GPIO footprint along the top. z not given on the official drawing.

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 4 holes at (3.5, 3.5), (61.5, 3.5), (3.5, 26.5), (61.5, 26.5); pattern 58 × 23 mm. Hole diameter not stated on the official drawing (Zero family is commonly M2.5 / ø2.75; unverified)

features.label: GPIO footprint
features.value: 2×20, centre at x = 32.5 (29 mm right of the top-left hole), on the top hole line

amazon.title: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (Wireless / Bluetooth) 2021 (RPi Zero 2W)

notes: No official STEP from Raspberry Pi (the Zero 2 W portal category lists only PDFs: drawing, brief, schematics, test pads, case drawings). Mounting-hole diameter and component heights are not on the official drawing; need a measurement or a vetted model.
